name: ecommerce-api-qa
description: QA test suite for the e-commerce backend API (Postman/newman)

scripts.test:run: mkdir -p test-reports && newman run postman/ecommerce-api-tests.postman_collection.json -e postman/ecommerce-api-environment.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,json,htmlextra --reporter-json-export test-reports/results.json --reporter-htmlextra-export test-reports/report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "E-Commerce API QA" --suppress-exit-code
